# Leak patterns that ship WITH the repository.
#
# The maintainer's private list (.github/sanitization-patterns.txt) names the
# specific terms that must never appear here, so it is gitignored and CI never
# sees it. That left the publish pipeline with no leak gate at all: `sanitize`
# had zero occurrences in any workflow, and the only gate was a local pre-push
# hook that a CI-triggered release never runs.
#
# This file closes that hole with patterns that describe SHAPES rather than
# values -- a credential's format, a home directory's layout, a consumer mail
# domain. Nothing personal is encoded here, so it can live in a public repo,
# and it catches the classes of leak that matter without needing to know which
# machine or which person the repo was authored on.
#
# One pattern per line, POSIX extended regex (grep -E), case-insensitive.
# Lines that are empty or start with `#` are ignored. No PCRE constructs:
# lookahead is unavailable in `grep -E` and would fail only on some platforms,
# which is the worst way for a gate to fail.
#
# Adding a pattern: run `bash .github/scripts/sanitize.sh` first. A pattern
# that fires on the existing tree is a false positive to narrow, not a leak to
# announce -- an instrument's fault is not the subject's fault.

# --- Credential shapes ---------------------------------------------------
-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----
\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}
\bsk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}
\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}
\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b
\bxox[baprs]-[0-9]{10,}-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}\b
\bnpm_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}\b
\bpypi-AgEIcHlwaS5vcmc[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}
\bglpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}

# --- A local machine's user directory names a person ---------------------
[Cc]:[\\/]+Users[\\/]+[A-Za-z0-9._-]+

# --- Consumer mailboxes --------------------------------------------------
# A project contact belongs on a project domain. A personal inbox in public
# source is a leak whoever it belongs to.
[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@(gmail|googlemail|outlook|hotmail|live|yahoo|ymail|proton|protonmail|yandex|icloud|aol)\.[a-z]{2,}
